human_locus: For each regarded (H)ERV-W locus, chromosomal bands (proviral loci indicated in bold, loci lacking both LTRs in italics) are given for the regarded locus in the human GRCh37/hg19 reference genome sequence (for precise start and end positions, see Grandi et al. 2016). Chromosome coordinates of orthologous ERV-W loci are given for the other regarded non-human Catarrhini primate reference genome sequences. Apparent absence of a (H)ERV-W sequence in the orthologous genome position of other primate genome sequences is indicated by "x". Two HERV-W loci on the human chromosome Y were excluded from the analysis (see main paper text).
